lines: <str>I spoke to Ivy Sophista in Taverley. She directed me to
<str>Thaerisk, the leader of a group of Guthixians called Crux Eqal.
<str>Thaerisk asked me to help deal with the growing threat posed
<str>by Lucien. Before he could tell me more, we were attacked by
<str>Assassins. However, we were able to defeat them.
<str>With the Assassins dealt with, Thaerisk asked me to
<str>investigate a treasure hunter called Movario who he believed
<str>had worked with Lucien. He suggested I start my search at the
<str>Fight Arena as Movario hired a bodyguard from there called
<str>Darve.
<str>I travelled to the Fight Arena and found a Launderer who knew
<str>Movario. He gave me a Dirty Shirt belonging to him and
<str>directed me to the Hunting Expert in the Feldip Hills to ask
<str>about obtaining a Broav to track Movario with.
<str>I spoke to the Hunting Expert and she showed me how to catch
<str>and train a Broav.
<str>I returned to the Fight Arena and was able to use my Broav to
<str>track Movario's scent to a Hidden Base below the Khazard
<str>Battlefield.
<str>I found some Research Notes within the Hidden Base and took
<str>them to Thaerisk in Taverley.
<str>Thaerisk asked me to head to McGrubor's Wood to find Idria
<str>and the Guardians of Armadyl, as he'd lost contact with them.
<str>Upon arrival, I found them being attacked by some
<str>Mercenaries, but I was able to help defeat them.
<str>With the Mercenaries dealt with, Idria and I journeyed to the
<str>White Knights' Castle in Falador. There we met up with
<str>Thaerisk, as well as Akrisae of the Temple Knights.
<str>I spoke with Thaerisk, Akrisae and Idria about the contents of
<str>Movario's Research Notes. They revealed Lucien's desire to
<str>find and claim an artefact of unimaginable power called the
<str>Stone of Jas.
<str>To find Lucien, Thaerisk suggested we capture one of his
<str>Spies from Draynor Village. As such, I planted a Teleorb given
<str>to me by Akrisae on one of them. He then used this Teleorb to
<str>teleport the Spy into a cell.
<str>With the Spy captured, we attempted to interrogate him using
<str>some Truth Serum. However, the Spy was able to destroy it.
<str>To make some more Truth Serum, I prepared an Enriched
<str>Snapdragon Seed and planted it in a Specially Prepared Patch
<str>on the roof of the White Knights' Castle. While waiting for it to
<str>grow, I recruited Turael, Mazchna, Duradel and Cyrisus to our
<str>cause.
<str>I harvested the Enriched Snapdragon and used it to make
<str>some new Truth Serum. I then administered the Truth Serum to
<str>the Spy and he provided details on an individual known as the
<str>Dark Squall.
<col=000080>Based on the information provided, <col=800000>Idria<col=000080> and <col=800000>Akrisae<col=000080> initiated
<col=000080>a search for the <col=800000>Dark Squall<col=000080>. I then recruited <col=800000>Harrallak
<col=800000>Menarous<col=000080>, <col=800000>Ghommal<col=000080> and <col=800000>Sloane<col=000080> to our cause. I should speak
<col=000080>to the others about what to do next.
<str>I spoke to King Bolren who told me that one of their orbs of
<str>protection has been stolen by Khazard troops.
<str>I spoke to Montai. The orb was in the Khazard stronghold
<str>North of the battlefield, but it was secure in there.
<str>I brought Montai logs to help fortify their defences.
<str>Now their defences were secure, they were ready to use the
<str>Gnome Ballista to break through the enemy defences.
<str>I found the three trackers and used their coordinates to fire
<str>the ballista straight into the Khazard stronghold.
<str>With the stronghold breached by ballista fire, I was able to
<str>make my way inside and recover the orb of protection.
<str>I returned the orb to King Bolren, but while I was busy getting
<str>it the Khazard troops invaded the village and stole the
<str>remaining two orbs before heading north.
<str>After a fierce battle I defeated the warlord who'd stolen the
<str>orbs, and reclaimed them for the gnome people.
<str>I returned them to King Bolren, and was rewarded for all of my
<str>help to the Gnome people in recovering the orbs.
<str>I can now use the gnome's spirit tree to teleport around the
<str>world to places that are linked to the spirit tree!
<col=ff0000>QUEST COMPLETE!
<str>I spoke to a Guard outside the Carnillean Mansion in East
<str>Ardougne. He asked me to help him investigate a crime at the
<str>Mansion.
<str>I met with the Guard upstairs to discover that the crime was in
<str>fact the murder of Ceril Carnillean. I had a look around the
<str>crime scene and found a few things of interest.
<str>I discussed my discoveries with the Guard, and he showed me
<str>an Amulet he'd found. The Amulet had the symbol of the
<str>Khazard Army on it. The name Evelot was also engraved into it.
<str>I travelled to the Fight Arena Bar to try and find Evelot. I paid
<str>the Barman there for some information, and he told me she'd
<str>left the Bar just before I arrived.
<str>I was able to pick up Evelot's trail outside the Fight Arena Bar.
<str>I followed this trail and found her by a Rowboat south of the
<str>Tower of Life. She tried to fight me off, but I was able to
<str>overpower her.
<str>I confronted Evelot and asked her what she knew about Ceril
<str>Carnillean's murder. She admitted to being at the Carnillean
<str>Mansion, but claimed to know nothing about his death.
<str>Instead, she said she'd been paid to steal Hazeel's
<str>Restoration Scroll and then deliver it to the Hazeel Cult.
<str>I travelled to the Hazeel Cult Hideout in the Sewers south of
<str>East Ardougne. At my request, Hazeel himself was summoned.
<str>Upon telling him about my investigation, he called upon
<str>General Khazard.
<str>I discussed my investigation with Hazeel and General
<str>Khazard. They weren't happy about an unknown individual
<str>interfering with their affairs and wanted to find who killed
<str>Ceril Carnillean as well.
<str>At Hazeel's suggestion, I return to the Carnillean Mansion to
<str>question the family and staff about the murder. Claus, the
<str>family chef, mentioned feeling a strange cold sensation down
<str>in the Kitchen at the time of the murder. I then found a
<str>passage leading to a Hidden Room while exploring the Kitchen.
<str>Within the Hidden Room beneath the Carnillean Mansion, I
<str>found a Locked Chest with a Dusty Scroll inside. The scroll
<str>depicted half of a Crest of some sorts.
<str>I returned to the Hazeel Cult Hideout and discussed the Crest
<str>with Hazeel and General Khazard. They seemed to know what it
<str>was, but did not enlighten me on the details. Instead, they
<str>decided to head north, and asked me to meet them at Weiss.
<str>I met with Hazeel and General Khazard at Weiss. At their
<str>request, I spoke to Snowflake and My Arm and they told me a
<str>Strange Shadow was seen down in the Salt Mine.
<str>Hazeel and General Khazard decided to investigate the Salt
<str>Mine, but they first speculated that the recent occurrences
<str>might be connected to a Ritual the Mahjarrat use to ensure
<str>their survival.
<str>Within the Salt Mine, we found a cave-in leading to a Frozen
<str>Dungeon. Within this dungeon, General Khazard and I found
<str>the Assassin who I'd previously encountered on Entrana. He
<str>was trying to open a Large Door. However, he escaped after
<str>we confronted him.
<str>I told Hazeel about the Assassin and he revealed the Large
<str>Door to be an entry to a Prison. He also told me that the Door
<str>was sealed long ago using the Crest I found a depiction of.
<str>Hazeel suspected that half of this Crest was stolen from the
<str>Carnillean Mansion when Ceril Carnillean was killed. Hazeel
<str>then told me that the other half was in possession of a
<str>Mahjarrat who he believed could be hidden nearby.
<str>While exploring the Frozen Dungeon, I found a cave leading to
<str>a Strange Creature. I fought off the Creature and it
<str>transformed into a Mahjarrat called Jhallan.
<str>Before I could properly confront Jhallan, the Assassin
<str>reappeared and captured him. The Assassin then used the
<str>half of the Crest that was in Jhallan's possession to enter
<str>the Prison.
<str>I spoke to Hazeel and General Khazard about the Assassin,
<str>but they didn't wish to follow him into the Prison. Instead,
<str>they decided to post guards outside to inform them if the
<str>Assassin reappeared. I returned to the Guard at the
<str>Carnillean Mansion and let him know what happened. He was
<str>disappointed the Assassin got away, but thanked me all the
<str>same.
<col=ff0000>QUEST COMPLETE!

_provenance: Captured from the live client. While Guthix Sleeps is exact: its 51 lines were confirmed against a real end-to-end capture through the deployed Worker. The other two captures were reconstructed from a log of Java's List.toString() and may split a line on an internal comma; they are used only for properties that do not depend on line boundaries.
